prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1247; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with injuries sustained in a rear-end collision involving the insured under your policy. Effective immediately, please direct all communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of the policy in force at the time of the accident, along with the identity of any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this file.

We further demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes, without limitation, the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, adjuster notes, vehicle data and telematics records, repair estimates, and any dashcam or surveillance footage. Any destruction, alteration, or loss of such material may expose your insured and your company to sanctions.

Please acknowledge receipt of this letter in writing within ten business days. We look forward to your prompt response.
